data.statement: Causal-scope correction for evt-20260828-v4-public-learning: the three truthful v4 creatives total 214 public impressions, led directionally by the goat at 131 impressions, two Pin clicks, and one save; the alligator has 68 impressions and the ceramic eye has 15, with no public outbound click, attributable Pinterest session, or affiliate click for any of them.
data.decision: Keep the corrected goat as the only directional attention leader and keep all three published v4 candidates in measurement; do not use this small public-performance increment to justify work in another experiment.
data.nextAction: Continue public-only v4 measurement and never use Sandbox or Pinterest v3 as traffic evidence.
